original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Deploy Java application as systemd service
  hosts: all
  become: true

  vars:
    app_name: myapp
    service_user: myapp
    service_group: myapp

    app_home: "/opt/{{ app_name }}"
    app_data_dir: "/var/lib/{{ app_name }}"
    app_jar_src: "files/{{ app_name }}.jar"
    app_jar_dest: "{{ app_home }}/app.jar"

    env_default_file: "/etc/default/{{ app_name }}"
    env_sysconfig_file: "/etc/sysconfig/{{ app_name }}"
    service_unit_path: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ app_name }}.service"

    service_description: "{{ app_name | capitalize }} Java Service"
    java_bin_path: "/usr/bin/java"

    java_opts_default: "-Xms256m -Xmx512m -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError"
    app_args_default: ""

    java_packages_by_distribution:
      Ubuntu: openjdk-21-jre-headless
      Debian: openjdk-21-jre-headless
      RedHat: java-21-openjdk-headless
      CentOS: java-21-openjdk-headless
      Rocky: java-21-openjdk-headless
      AlmaLinux: java-21-openjdk-headless
      OracleLinux: java-21-openjdk-headless
      Fedora: java-21-openjdk-headless
    java_packages_by_os_family:
      Debian: openjdk-21-jre-headless
      RedHat: java-21-openjdk-headless
    default_java_package: java-21-openjdk-headless

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Determine Java package name
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        java_package_name: "{{ java_packages_by_distribution.get(ansible_distribution, java_packages_by_os_family.get(ansible_os_family, default_java_package)) }}"

    - name: Ensure apt cache is up to date (Debian/Ubuntu)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == 'Debian'

  tasks:
    - name: Install OpenJDK 21
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ java_package_name }}"
        state: present

    - name: Ensure group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ service_group }}"
        system: true
        state: present

    - name: Ensure service user exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ service_user }}"
        group: "{{ service_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        create_home: false
        home: "/nonexistent"
        state: present

    - name: Create application directories
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ item.owner | default('root') }}"
        group: "{{ item.group | default(service_group) }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode | default('0750') }}"
      loop:
        - { path: "{{ app_home }}", owner: "root", group: "{{ service_group }}", mode: "0750" }
        - { path: "{{ app_data_dir }}", owner: "{{ service_user }}", group: "{{ service_group }}", mode: "0750" }

    - name: Deploy application JAR
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ app_jar_src }}"
        dest: "{{ app_jar_dest }}"
        owner: "root"
        group: "{{ service_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        backup: yes
      notify: Restart {{ app_name }} service

    - name: Create environment file for Debian-based systems
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ env_default_file }}"
        owner: "root"
        group: "root"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible
          JAVA_OPTS="{{ java_opts_default }}"
          APP_ARGS="{{ app_args_default }}"
      notify: Restart {{ app_name }} service

    - name: Create environment file for RedHat-based systems
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ env_sysconfig_file }}"
        owner: "root"
        group: "root"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible
          JAVA_OPTS="{{ java_opts_default }}"
          APP_ARGS="{{ app_args_default }}"
      notify: Restart {{ app_name }} service

    - name: Create systemd unit file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ service_unit_path }}"
        owner: "root"
        group: "root"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description={{ service_description }}
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ service_user }}
          Group={{ service_group }}
          WorkingDirectory={{ app_data_dir }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ env_default_file }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ env_sysconfig_file }}
          ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c '/usr/bin/test -x {{ java_bin_path }} && /usr/bin/test -r {{ app_jar_dest }}'
          ExecStart={{ java_bin_path }} $JAVA_OPTS -jar {{ app_jar_dest }} $APP_ARGS
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s
          SuccessExitStatus=143
          UMask=0027

          NoNewPrivileges=yes
          PrivateTmp=yes
          PrivateDevices=yes
          ProtectSystem=full
          ProtectHome=read-only
          ReadOnlyPaths={{ app_home }}
          ProtectControlGroups=yes
          ProtectKernelTunables=yes
          ProtectKernelModules=yes
          ProtectKernelLogs=yes
          LockPersonality=yes
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
          RestrictNamespaces=yes
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
          SystemCallArchitectures=native
          SystemCallFilter=@system-service
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          KillSignal=SIGTERM
          TimeoutStopSec=30

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify:
        - Reload systemd
        - Restart {{ app_name }} service

    - name: Ensure service is enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: false

  handlers:
    - name: Reload systemd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Restart {{ app_name }} service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        state: restarted
        enabled: true
